headline: TasteVal reports a 2.30× experimental-compute multiplier for Opus 5.5 on eight bounded AI R&D tasks
summary: Jaffe and Sherburn introduce TasteVal, an author-built benchmark of eight text and vision tasks intended to measure experimental design and interpretation when a fixed research problem is given. They report that Opus 5.5 (max) reaches a 2.30× experimental-compute multiplier against the best expert attempt per task (95% CI 1.15–4.37). The authors also estimate that frontier-model multiplier performance doubled about every 3.0 months after December 2025, while final normalized performance shows no corresponding trend break. These are preprint results on withheld tasks, not evidence that models choose valuable research questions or outperform experts across broad research work.
